## How to update when labels grow

```bash
uv run --extra dev --with pyarrow python scripts/build_extraction_status.py --from-hub --commit <40-hex> --revision <tag>
uv run python scripts/render_gt_coverage.py --write
```

No code edit is needed for a field to become scored: its status follows the populated share in the rebuilt status file. Check that `scripts/freeze_goldens.py --check` still passes, and add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
